facts.fact: The APDP president, opening the authority's second ordinary session on 2026-08-03, cited Law no. 2013-015 of 21 May 2013 (as amended) as the basis for the authority's sanctions.
The APDP held its second ordinary session on 2026-08-03 under president Pr Mamoudou Samassekou with all commissioners present.

The session of 2026-08-03 had over 1,000 files to examine, covering authorisations, declarations, video-surveillance, formal notices and direct sanction procedures; the article gives no figures for sanctions issued.
